pride_data.title: Identification of Bik1 XL peptides (DSS)
pride_data.projectDescription: Effect of different DSS concentrations and varying collision energy on the number of identified crosslinks.
pride_data.sampleProcessingProtocol: Bik1 FL samples (50µg, ~1mg/ml) were subjected to a crosslinking reaction with 1 mM isotope labelled di-succimidylsuberate (DSS-d0 and DSS-d12; CreativeMolecules Inc.).  After 30 min of incubation at 37C and 700rpm agitation in thermomixer, samples were quenched with 50mM NH3HCO3 pH =8. Upon quenching, samples were dried, dissolved in 8 M Urea, reduced with 5 mM TCEP, and alkylated with 10 mM iodoacetamide. The proteolysis was performed overnight at 37 ⁰C in 1M urea using trypsin 1:50 E:S, and then quenched with 5% formic acid. Generated peptides were subjected to cleanup (C18 column, TheNest Group) and separated by SEC using an ÄKTA micro chromatography system (GE Healthcare) using a Superdex 200 Increase 3.2/30 column (Cytiva). The SEC fractions (4) were then dried and re-dissolved in 5% acetonitrile and 0.1% formic acid for mass-spectrometry analysis. The detailed protocol of the reaction has been previously described by Leitner et al. [Leitner, Nat Protocol 2014]. LC-MS/MS measurements were performed on an Orbitrap QExactive+ mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher) coupled to an EASY-nLC-1000 liquid chromatography system (Thermo Fisher). Peptides were separated across a 60 min gradient: from 5% to 25% in 55 min and from 25% to 40% in 5 min (buffer A: 0.1% (v/v) formic acid; buffer B: 0.1% (v/v) formic acid, 95% (v/v) acetonitrile) using a reverse phase column (75 µm ID x 400 mm New Objective, in-house packed with ReproSil Gold 120 C18, 1.9 µm, Dr. Maisch GmbH). The acquisition method (DDA) was performed with one MS1 scan followed by a maximum of 20 scans for the top 20 most intense peptides (TOP20) with MS1 scans (R=70’000 at 400 m/z, max IT= 64ms AGC=1e5), HCD fragmentation (NCE=25 or 28%), isolation windows (1.5 m/z) and MS2 scans (R=35’000 at 400 m/z, maxIT = 110ms, AGC= 5e4ms). A dynamic exclusion of 30 sec was applied, and charge states lower than three and higher than seven were rejected for the isolation.
pride_data.dataProcessingProtocol: For the identification of crosslinking data, mass spectra were converted to mzXML format and searched with xQuest/xProphet [Leitner, Nat Procol 2014] against a database containing the FASTA sequence of Bik1 and its decoy sequence. Crosslinked peptides with ld.Score > 20, delta S > 0.95, and FDR < 0.05 were considered in the analysis.
